Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.description: Answers to the questions we hear most about AMOR LAB.

items.q: Q. Can I train at a regular gym without HYROX equipment?
items.a: Yes. We build substitute WODs around dumbbells, barbells and treadmills to develop the abilities HYROX requires.

items.q: Q. Can a complete beginner follow the program?
items.a: Absolutely. We adjust the plan to your current fitness level and build from the fundamentals without rushing.
Upload how your workout felt and the coach will provide form and pacing feedback within 48 hours.
